records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net revenue from our semiconductor solutions segment increased in the fiscal quarter and three fiscal quarters ended August 3, 2025 compared to the prior year fiscal periods due to strong demand for our networking products, primarily custom AI accelerators and AI networking solutions.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net revenue from our infrastructure software segment increased in the fiscal quarter and three fiscal quarters ended August 3, 2025 compared to the prior year fiscal periods primarily due to strong demand for our VMware Cloud Foundation (“VCF”) product, including additional license revenue recognized on contracts where customers do not have the right to terminate and the transition to a subscription license model.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The increases were primarily due to higher software revenue and strong product demand for our AI-related semiconductor solutions.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Gross margin was $10,703 million for the fiscal quarter ended August 3, 2025 compared to $8,356 million for the fiscal quarter ended August 4, 2024, and $31,045 million for the three fiscal quarters ended August 3, 2025 compared to $23,507 million for the three fiscal quarters ended August 4, 2024.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Operating income from our semiconductor solutions segment increased for the fiscal quarter and three fiscal quarters ended August 3, 2025 compared to the prior year fiscal periods due to strong demand for our networking products, primarily custom AI accelerators and AI networking solutions.
